acts.title: The Bay
acts.blurb: Learn to dive as a team: one job each, one trick at a time.

acts.title: The Carved Wreck
acts.blurb: The tablets point to a wreck, and the wreck points somewhere deeper.

acts.title: The Drowned Road
acts.blurb: Follow the paved sea floor to the place the carvings warned about.

twists.how: The chapter counts as won only if the dive is completed with G.att <= param (attempts on the same G object via LD.nextAttempt).
The chapter counts as won only if G.distress is still false when the dive is completed, so the team must finish without lighting the distress flare.
Every computer teammate is created with ai level param (e.g. 'easy') in the ai array passed to LD.newGame instead of the chapter's teammate level.
The dive is started with players = param (e.g. 5) in LD.newGame, so the same dive is drawn with the larger team's job values and fewer tricks each.
For a dive that has a clock in its logbook entry (dives 14, 15, 16, 26), LD.newGame is called with timer: true so the real-time rule is played with the clock instead of its no-clock alternative.

intro.text: Welcome to Saltmere Base. Before you dive for real, one small job in the bay.
I'm new too! Win the trick your job asks for and we all go home dry.
Follow the coach. Nothing down there can hurt you today.

outro.text: Job done, logbook signed. You're a diver now.
Fishermen hauled up two carved stones this morning. Someone should look.

opponent.name: Calm Shallows
opponent.personality: Clear, warm water. The only danger is forgetting to follow suit.

goal.text: Complete dive 1, Shallow Water: finish your one job.

stars.text: Complete it on the first attempt

easier.text: The guided deal is already the gentlest dive; the coach shows every step.

intro.text: Two jobs this time. The Commander picks first, then each diver in turn.
Pick the job your hand can win. Big cards win tricks; Lanterns beat every colour.
Find where those stones came from.

outro.text: Both jobs done. The stones match a ledge just past the base.

opponent.name: Drifting Sand
opponent.personality: Shifts under your fins and hides small cards where you least expect them.

goal.text: Complete dive 2, The First Tide: every job done.

stars.text: Take at least one job yourself

easier.text: Your teammates play their very best and the coach stays on.

intro.text: The base is ours now. Check all five chambers before we move in.
More jobs means more talking. Show one card with your ping: your highest, lowest or only one.
A good ping tells the team what you can win. Try one!

outro.text: See? One card shown and everyone knew where to play.
All systems hum. Rest up; the current is turning grey out by the wreck.

opponent.name: Flickering Power
opponent.personality: The lights blink in every chamber, and so do your plans if nobody signals.

goal.text: Complete dive 5, Five Chambers: every job done.

stars.text: Use your ping at least once
Complete it without the distress flare

easier.text: Your teammates play their very best and the coach stays on.

intro.text: The stones lead to an old wreck, and a grey current wraps around it.
Show me your cards, little lamps. I will blur every mark you make.
Murky water: your ping shows the card but not whether it's high, low or only. Think it through.

outro.text: Through the current and into the hold. There's a tablet in here, snapped in half.
Bring it home. Act one is done, divers.

opponent.name: The Grey Undertow
opponent.personality: Patient and smothering. It never strikes; it just makes every message vague.
opponent.taunt: Lost in the grey. Your signals meant nothing to them.
opponent.praise: You read meaning in my fog. Go on, then. Take the wreck.

goal.text: Complete dive 9, The Old Wreck, in murky water.

stars.text: Complete it without the distress flare

easier.text: Your team dives the clear-water slope (dive 7) instead of the murky wreck.

intro.text: The tablet is carved in signs nobody knows. One diver should study it alone.
Commander's call: the Commander takes every job, or hands them all to one willing diver.
A gentle start. Choose well and the rest follows.

outro.text: The signs describe a coastline. Not ours. Not any coast on our charts.

opponent.name: The Broken Tablet
opponent.personality: Half a message, and half a message is a riddle.

goal.text: Complete dive 10, The Inscription: every job done.

stars.text: Complete it without the distress flare

easier.text: A team of three with your strongest teammates.

intro.text: The base radio answered the tablet's pattern. Something down there is listening.
Deep narcosis today: a few shared ping tokens in the middle. Anyone may grab one between tricks.
So don't waste them. One good signal beats three nervous ones.

outro.text: The signal repeats: a direction. North, and down.
There's a maze of tunnels north of the wreck. Get some sleep.

opponent.name: The Narcosis Hum
opponent.personality: A soft ringing in your ears that makes every diver want to speak at once.

goal.text: Complete dive 11, Whispers, with the shared ping tokens.

easier.text: A team of three with your strongest teammates.

intro.text: The tunnels fork again and again, and the radio drops out every few metres.
Every turn of mine looks like the last. Which signal will you trust today?
Unknown waters: a drawn card picks the signalling rule. And nobody may win two more 1s than another.
Boss rule: no distress flare. If you light it, we pull you out.

outro.text: Out the far side. The sea floor there is flat. Too flat. Like stone slabs.
Slabs laid by hand. That's a road, divers.

opponent.name: The Thousand Turns
opponent.personality: A playful, endless maze. It loves a diver who guesses, and hates one who counts.
opponent.taunt: Left, right, left again. Back to the start with you.
opponent.praise: You counted every turn. I have nothing left to hide behind.

twist.text: Boss rule: the dive only counts if the team never lights the distress flare.

goal.text: Complete dive 20, The Labyrinth, without the distress flare.

stars.text: Use your ping at least once

easier.text: The flare is allowed again and your strongest teammates dive with you, three of you.

intro.text: At the start of the road: rooms full of stone shelves. Nobody we know built them.
Eleven points of jobs and a random signalling rule. No special limits, though.
I've been practising. I won't let you down this time.

outro.text: Told you! And look: the shelves all point down the road.

opponent.name: The Silent Shelves
opponent.personality: Rows and rows of carved records. Too much to read, too little time.

goal.text: Complete dive 22, The Sunken Archive: every job done.

stars.text: Complete it without the distress flare

easier.text: A team of three with your strongest teammates.

intro.text: The road runs on into the dark. Fourteen points of jobs, the biggest load yet.
Open briefing: talk freely about who takes which job. Never about cards.
Split the load by what each of us is good at. Then trust each other.

outro.text: The road ends at a corridor. No light gets in. None comes out.
One last dive. Whatever is in there, you go in together.

opponent.name: The Long Road
opponent.personality: Straight, endless and heavy. It tires out a team that carries too much.

goal.text: Complete dive 28, The Paved Road: every job done.

easier.text: Your team dives the shorter road (dive 24, twelve points) with your strongest teammates.

intro.text: Lanterns. So many little lanterns. Down here they all go out.
Four fixed jobs: no tricks; exactly three in a row; two in a row; the first and the last trick.
Boss rule: air for only 4 attempts. Finish within 4 or we haul you up.
Together, then. Lanterns high.

outro.text: The corridor is lit end to end. You charted the drowned road, all of it.
And something down there finally saw a light it didn't put out.
The Deep Dive is open, divers. As deep as you dare.

opponent.name: The Lampless One
opponent.personality: Old, cold and curious. It does not hate the divers; it simply eats light.
opponent.taunt: Out goes the light. The corridor keeps you, as it kept the others.
opponent.praise: Four jobs, four lights, and none went out. Walk on, lightbearers.

twist.text: Boss rule: the dive only counts if the team completes it within 4 attempts.

goal.text: Complete dive 32, The Last Corridor, within 4 attempts.

stars.text: Complete it without the distress flare

easier.text: No attempt limit and a team of three with your strongest teammates.
